According to Reuters, Crixus, a few years ago, a few high-ranking man who dared to hit a brake on his car, and who had repeatedly stood up to Huang In-hoon’s high-risk bets, took over the burden at the moment of the crash, with every move under Wall Street. 19 minutes ago, the only man who dared to step on the brakes!

heads.en: The South's biggest underworld currency dealer who conspires to launder 600 million dollars and laughs at the hundreds of victims who deserve to be tricked, who earns their blood and blood and who sarcasms in the group, "so stupid they should be tricked!" The so-called "Golden Cows" of the largest underground virtual currency dealer in the south was found by the Takashi District Attorney's Office to be engaged in long-term fraud and money-laundering, not only by providing a manual for the teaching of war, but also by using foreign exchange exchanges to create break points, with illegal gold flows amounting to $686 million, with 395 people on board.
